description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for external functions, constants, and a nested MemorySnapshot class, serving as an interface for system-related data access.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: A class providing access to system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system metadata within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: A nested class within SystemInfo that captures a snapshot of memory-related metrics and can output its data as a JSON string.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable by name.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable by name, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the SystemInfo class.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representation of the memory snapshot.

methods.name: SwapTotal
methods.description: Returns total swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapFree
methods.description: Returns free swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapCached
methods.description: Returns cached swap memory in bytes.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates and returns a snapshot of current memory metrics.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns a high-resolution timestamp in microseconds.
